subject: Physics
prompt: Coulomb's law force between two charges q₁,q₂ separated by r
explain: Coulomb's law: electrostatic force varies inversely as square of separation.

subject: Physics
prompt: Value of Coulomb's constant k in SI units
explain: k = 9×10⁹ N m² C⁻² is the standard value of Coulomb's constant.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric field E due to a point charge q at distance r
explain: Electric field of a point charge falls as inverse square of distance.

subject: Physics
prompt: Dimension of electric field E
explain: E = F/q → [MLT⁻²]/[AT] = [MLT⁻³A⁻¹].

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric flux through a closed surface enclosing charge Q
explain: Gauss's law: total flux = Q_enclosed/ε₀.

subject: Physics
prompt: E just outside a conductor surface with surface charge density σ
explain: Boundary condition at conductor surface gives E = σ/ε₀ outward.

subject: Physics
prompt: E due to infinite line charge of linear charge density λ at distance r
explain: Gauss's law on cylindrical surface gives E = λ/(2πε₀r).

subject: Physics
prompt: E due to infinite plane sheet of charge density σ
explain: Infinite sheet: field on each side = σ/2ε₀, independent of distance.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric potential V due to point charge q at distance r
explain: Potential is work done per unit charge; V = kq/r for point charge.

subject: Physics
prompt: Relation between E and V in one dimension
explain: Electric field is negative gradient of potential.

subject: Physics
prompt: Work done moving charge q through potential difference ΔV
explain: W = q(V_f − V_i); work equals charge times potential difference.

subject: Physics
prompt: Potential at the center of a uniformly charged ring of charge Q, radius R
explain: Every element is equidistant R from center, so V = kQ/R.

subject: Physics
prompt: Capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor with area A, separation d
explain: C = ε₀A/d; capacitance increases with area and decreases with separation.

subject: Physics
prompt: Energy stored in a capacitor of capacitance C charged to voltage V
explain: Electrostatic energy U = ½CV² = Q²/2C = QV/2.

subject: Physics
prompt: Equivalent capacitance of capacitors C₁ and C₂ in series
explain: Series combination: reciprocals add → C = C₁C₂/(C₁+C₂).

subject: Physics
prompt: Effect of inserting dielectric (κ) in isolated charged capacitor on voltage
explain: Q constant, C increases to κC₀, so V = Q/C decreases by factor κ.

subject: Physics
prompt: Torque on electric dipole p in uniform field E at angle θ
explain: τ = p × E; magnitude = pE sinθ, tends to align dipole with field.

subject: Physics
prompt: Potential energy of electric dipole in uniform field E
explain: U = −p·E = −pE cosθ; minimum at θ=0 (stable equilibrium).

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric field on axial line of dipole at large distance r
explain: On axis (end-on position) E_axial = 2kp/r³ for r >> 2a.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric field on equatorial line of dipole at large distance r
explain: Equatorial field = kp/r³, half of axial field, directed opposite to p.

subject: Physics
prompt: Dimension of electric potential V
explain: V = W/q → [ML²T⁻²]/[AT] = [ML²T⁻³A⁻¹].

subject: Physics
prompt: Unit of permittivity of free space ε₀
explain: From F = q²/(4πε₀r²), ε₀ has units C² N⁻¹ m⁻² = F m⁻¹.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which quantity is conserved when capacitors are connected in parallel after charging?
explain: Charge redistributes but total charge Q₁+Q₂ is conserved; energy is lost.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electrostatic potential inside a conductor in electrostatic equilibrium
explain: E = 0 inside conductor → no potential gradient → V = constant inside.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric potential due to a uniformly charged ring at distance x on axis
explain: Potential is scalar sum; all charge at same distance √(R²+x²) from axial point.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric field at centre of a uniformly charged ring
explain: By symmetry, field contributions from opposite elements cancel, giving E = 0 at centre.

subject: Physics
prompt: E on axis of uniformly charged ring at distance x from centre
explain: Only axial components survive; transverse components cancel by symmetry.

subject: Physics
prompt: Capacitance of a spherical conductor of radius R
explain: V = kQ/R, so C = Q/V = R/k = 4πε₀R.

subject: Physics
prompt: Equivalent capacitance of C₁ and C₂ in parallel
explain: In parallel, capacitances add directly: C_eq = C₁ + C₂.

subject: Physics
prompt: Energy stored in capacitor expressed using charge Q and capacitance C
explain: U = Q²/2C is equivalent form of ½CV²; follows from Q = CV.

subject: Physics
prompt: Energy density in electric field E (in medium with ε₀)
explain: Energy per unit volume in electric field is u = ½ε₀E².

subject: Physics
prompt: When dielectric κ is inserted in capacitor connected to battery, capacitance becomes
explain: Dielectric increases capacitance by factor κ regardless of battery or isolation.

subject: Physics
prompt: Force between plates of a charged parallel plate capacitor (charge Q, area A)
explain: Each plate is in field of other (σ/2ε₀); force = Q·(σ/2ε₀) = Q²/2ε₀A.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric potential V at a point is defined as work done per unit ___
explain: V = W/q₀; work done by external agent bringing unit positive charge from ∞ to that point.

subject: Physics
prompt: Equipotential surfaces of a point charge are
explain: V = kq/r = const means r = const; these are concentric spheres around the point charge.

subject: Physics
prompt: Angle between electric field E and equipotential surface
explain: E = −dV/dl; E is always perpendicular to equipotential surfaces.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric dipole moment p direction convention
explain: By convention, dipole moment vector points from negative to positive charge.

subject: Physics
prompt: Net force on an electric dipole placed in a UNIFORM electric field
explain: In uniform field, forces on +q and −q are equal and opposite; net force = 0.

subject: Physics
prompt: Dimension of electric dipole moment p
explain: p = q·d; [C·m] = [A·T·L] = [A T L] in dimensional form.

subject: Physics
prompt: Gauss's law: flux through any closed surface depends on
explain: Φ = Q_enc/ε₀; external charges contribute zero net flux through a closed surface.

subject: Physics
prompt: Charge distribution on a conductor resides
explain: In electrostatic equilibrium, free charges reside entirely on the outer surface of a conductor.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric field inside a cavity of a conductor with no charge inside is
explain: By Gauss's law with no enclosed charge and E=0 inside conductor walls, E = 0 in cavity.

subject: Physics
prompt: Potential difference between two concentric spheres (radii a, b; charge Q on inner)
explain: V_a = kQ/a, V_b = kQ/b; ΔV = kQ(1/a−1/b) since a < b.

subject: Physics
prompt: On inserting dielectric κ in isolated capacitor, energy stored
explain: Q fixed; C increases to κC₀; U = Q²/2C → U₀/κ; energy decreases.

subject: Physics
prompt: Common potential when two charged capacitors C₁(V₁) and C₂(V₂) are connected
explain: Charge is conserved; total Q = C₁V₁+C₂V₂ distributes over total C = C₁+C₂.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which physical quantity has SI unit N·m²·C⁻¹?
explain: Φ = E·A has units N/C × m² = N·m²·C⁻¹; also equal to V·m.

subject: Physics
prompt: Stable equilibrium orientation of electric dipole p in uniform field E
explain: U = −pE cosθ is minimum (most negative) at θ = 0°; this is stable equilibrium.

subject: Physics
prompt: Capacitance of an isolated spherical capacitor (inner r₁, outer r₂)?
explain: Spherical capacitor capacitance is 4πε₀ times the product divided by difference of radii.

subject: Physics
prompt: Electric potential due to a short dipole at angle θ, distance r from centre?
explain: Dipole potential depends on orientation: V = kp cosθ/r²; zero at θ = 90°.

subject: Physics
prompt: If a charge q is placed at centre of a cube, flux through ONE face is?
explain: Total flux = q/ε₀ by Gauss's law; symmetry divides it equally among 6 faces.
